Name: Maggs Ghost Dire Wolf Mount - Custom Mounts
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

[b][color=#93c47d][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
Download the zip file, then unzip it to your mods folder. See SMAPI for more help if needed.
Updating: delete the old Maggs Dire Wolf folder in your mods folder, then unzip the new version to your mods folder.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35810]Custom Mounts[/url], this mod will not work on its own.

[color=#93c47d][size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size][/color]
Adds a dire wolf with a shelter in Robin's farm buildings list. Custom Mounts allows you to have multiple stables on your farm. 
[list]
[*]Ghostly wolf with a matching skull cave shelter.
[*]Shelters require 15,000 gold, 100 hardwood, and 20 moss, they are instant-build. [b][color=#00ffff]Note:[/color][/b] since they are instant build, your wolf will appear the next day after a save.
[*]Wolves enjoy sashimi, feeding them will grant a speed boost.
[*]Wolves respond to the bone flute. 
[*]Howling sound effect for the animation. This can be turned off in the configuration menu.
[*]Wolves do not enjoy hats, if we can customize hats for the howling animation, I will add the feature. So maybe at some point, but no promises!
[/list]
Includes Deutsch and Español translations along with seasonal shelter colors thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Smapifan?gameId=1303]Smapifan[/url]﻿!

[color=#93c47d][size=4][b]Future Updates[/b][/size][/color]
